answer_1.quote: Question Generation (QG) aims to teach machines to ask human-like questions from a range of inputs such as natural language texts , images  and knowledge bases .

answer_2.quote: Following the conventions, we used BLEU , ROUGE-L  and METEOR  as automatic evaluation metrics.

answer_4.quote: We randomly selected 20 passages from the test set with 207 given answers and asked 10 native speakers to evaluate the outputs of each model independently.
answer_4.guideline: Under each aspect, reviewers are asked to choose a score from {1, 2, 3}, where 3 indicates the best quality.
